llm_prompt_text:
Analyze this vulnerability.
    
    Description: CWD ~root command in ftpd allows root access.
    Affected Software (CPEs): cpe:2.3:a:ftp:ftp:*:*:*:*:*:*:*:*, cpe:2.3:a:ftpcd:ftpcd:*:*:*:*:*:*:*:*

llm_prompt_text:
Analyze this vulnerability.
    
    Description: Buffer overflow in passwd in BSD based operating systems 4.3 and earlier allows local users to gain root privileges by specifying a long shell or GECOS field.
    Affected Software (CPEs): cpe:2.3:o:bsd:bsd:4.2:*:*:*:*:*:*:*, cpe:2.3:o:bsd:bsd:4.3:*:*:*:*:*:*:*
affected_technology: passwd in BSD based operating systems 4.3 and earlier
plain_english_summary: A buffer overflow vulnerability in the 'passwd' program on BSD based operating systems version 4.3 and earlier allows a local user to gain root privileges by providing an excessively long shell or GECOS field.

llm_prompt_text:
Analyze this vulnerability.
    
    Description: Vulnerability in rcp on SunOS 4.0.x allows remote attackers from trusted hosts to execute arbitrary commands as root, possibly related to the configuration of the nobody user.
    Affected Software (CPEs): cpe:2.3:o:sun:sunos:4.0:*:*:*:*:*:*:*, cpe:2.3:o:sun:sunos:4.0.1:*:*:*:*:*:*:*, cpe:2.3:o:sun:sunos:4.0.2:*:*:*:*:*:*:*, cpe:2.3:o:sun:sunos:4.0.3:*:*:*:*:*:*:*, cpe:2.3:o:sun:sunos:4.0.3c:*:*:*:*:*:*:*
plain_english_summary: A security flaw in the 'rcp' command on SunOS 4.0.x allows remote attackers from trusted systems to execute any command they wish with root (administrator) privileges. This issue might be related to how the 'nobody' user is configured.
